tasks.title: The two questions and their reader
The engine asks at both moments and records the answers

beliefs.claim: In a scripted Flock run, two tasks that both replace the same base line merge as a union (adds only), which never blocks, so no R: task is added. To force a resolve task, have one side keep the line and add after it while the other replaces it (fleet/tests/flock_jev_trials_probe.mjs).
